dialogues.speaker: Inconsistently-Written Notes
dialogues.text: (The most recent page of Arashakun's journal is written in huge letters.)

dialogues.speaker: Inconsistently-Written Notes
dialogues.text: #"With the help of the amazing Golden Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, Arashakun found 'courage' again!"

dialogues.speaker: Inconsistently-Written Notes
dialogues.text: "Not just that, we also destroyed the Furry Mask Demon King together!"

dialogues.speaker: Inconsistently-Written Notes
dialogues.text: #"Nara {NICKNAME} is also a brave and kind Nara!"
